groups.summary: Four pickleball lovers, all free Wednesday evening, all within budget for a free event, were proposed, said yes twice and were locked without any conflict. The matchmaking logic was sound and the agents followed their profiles. The main flaws are in the final wrap-up: one message credits Quinn with a love of live music that his profile does not contain, the headline names Black Diamond while the courts are in Maple Valley, and one early pitch overstated how many baseball fans were in the group.
groups.compatibility: All four list pickleball as a love and exactly four makes a doubles rotation, so the core fit is strong. Secondary overlaps exist (live music for Andres/Kevin/Heather, running for Quinn/Kevin/Heather, baseball for Quinn/Kevin); the 30-to-64 age spread is a mild stretch but nothing in the profiles clashes. No one else from the break room was available to compare.
